description: List valid deploy targets for rollback. Returns previous successful deploys that can be rolled back to, with id, status, trigger, commit info, and completion timestamp. Use before rollback_deploy to show the user which versions are available. Returns up to 10 most recent successful deploys, excluding the current live deploy. For multi-service projects, use service_id to filter.

service_id.description: Optional service ID for multi-service projects.

name: list_rollback_targets
